name: Add Passkey Success
summary: An authenticated existing user opens passkey enrollment from Passkey Management, completes a platform passkey creation ceremony, and returns to Passkey Management with a new credential bound to the same durable identity.
finalOutcome: A new passkey credential is registered to the current durable identity, the active session identity is unchanged, and the refreshed management list includes the new credential.

sourceReferences.note: Existing-user registration issues a user-bound challenge, excludes already-registered credentials, validates the consumed challenge and embedded FIDO user id, and persists the new credential without changing durable identity.

Passkey Management owns authenticated existing-user enrollment. Anonymous passkey account creation remains a separate Passkey Registration category. Successful management enrollment returns directly to Manage Passkeys rather than requiring a separate confirmation screen.
